name: Example: assert_js with a Promise-based wait
label: example/assert_js
description: Shows the {pass, reason} contract and a native Promise wait (no async_script split).

steps.script: return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r({pass: document.getElementById('out').textContent === 'ready', reason: 'text was ' + document.getElementById('out').textContent}), 500))
steps.comment: Playwright awaits the returned Promise automatically
